test_title: PYST 8: SSC JE ME- General Intelligence (Held On 11 Oct 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six friends are sitting in a circle facing the centre. Sumit sits second to the right of Amit. Karan is an immediate neighbour of Param. Tony sits third to the right of Amit. Dharam is an immediate neighbour of Amit and Sumit. Karan sits second to the right of Sumit.

Who sits to the immediate left of Amit?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Sumit sits second to the right of Amit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4201a740d74527962bba129ba79220d95312e2a0b72807c47c3e8cea99f747dd.png] 

2) Tony sits third to the right of Amit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6fef844f203658d67f37514a762401d96fca59319825d01f1b43321d0ef6a3f7.png] 

3) Karan sits second to the right of Sumit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78ac27929105bd0b11fb439661b027c54643353e39fc4494275564ee0b6cf153.png] 

4) Dharam is an immediate neighbour of Amit and Sumit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a01d8f04c591df29b73ea110476261832f01262ac79f3b5d365a4b5050d8c93.png] 

Thus, the final arrangement is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79c81c39e64382877706e58fa11a99203e2347205501da55298b2141ecaa0eaa.png] 

Here, we can see that Param sits to the immediate left of Amit.

Hence, the correct answer is **"****Param"**.
